title: email-template-builder.html
content: Known Issue: Email Template Builder Event Organizers can edit existing Email Templates in the Email Template Builder without the Email Template displaying a blank screen. However, for those who can’t update the Salesforce package, we recommend using one of the following workarounds. Use a classic Email Template or a Firefox browser. For Chrome users, clear the cache and hard refresh the page if the Email Template Builder loads with a blank screen. Create beautiful reminders and post- {{variable.Object_Event}} emails in Salesforce with a no-code editor (no need to create an email using HMTL/CSS). Before You Start Configure the UID The Email Settings’ Custom Setting Custom Email Builder UID Handler field gives you more control when setting UID for special use cases. The Custom Email Builder UID Handler field defines a custom handler. Use the following format to configure the new field as "TestUIDHandler." 1 public class TestUIDHandler implements EmailEditorUIDInterface{ 2 public String getUID(){ 3 return '1234567890'; 4 } 5} Update the Event Object’s Page Layout Add the "Email Templates" Related List to the Event object’s page layout. Go to Setup. Click the Object Manager tab. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Event” (conference360__Event__c). Click the Page Layouts tab and click the layout you want to update. Click the Related Lists tab. Locate “Email Templates” and drag and drop it on the page layout. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Check Permission Sets Confirm that you have the correct permissions. The Email Template Builder creates the Classic Email Template located within Setup. Users who want to create or view Email Templates need the following permissions: Permission Sets Blackthorn | Events (Admin) or Blackthorn | Events (Organizer) Blackthorn | Payments (Admin) System Permissions Author Apex Create Content Deliveries Customize Application Edit Read-Only Fields Manage Custom Permissions Modify Metadata Through Metadata API Functions View Setup and Configuration View Roles and Role Hierarchy If you are running into insufficient privileges, please watch this troubleshooting video. Create Out-of-the-Box Email Templates Navigate to the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} tab. Click the Configuration tab. Click {{variable.Button_CreateEmailTemplates}} . Here is a quick video on how to create templates! Flows and Email Templates Using Email Templates and flows (previously workflows) together can create problems. For example, if an Attendee’s {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} is set to “To Invite” and an Email Template email is sent, the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} field automatically updates to “Invited.” If you intend to use this feature, we recommend disabling the “Send Blackthorn | Event invite email” flow. Instructions Functionality Update The Email Template builder functionality no longer avoids MSO code. You can now import Classic Email Templates into Blackthorn Events. Start Here Setting up your first template is simple! Navigate to an {{variable.Object_Event}} record. New Email Templates can only be created from the Email Template Builder component in an Event record.   On the "Email Templates" related list, click the dropdown arrow and click "New". On the "New Template" modal, select "New" and click {{variable.Button_Continue}} . Note: The "New From Template" option will create a new template from an existing template. (Optional) : If you want to check out a template, we have included 12 by default. Standard Template | Invite Light Standard Template | Confirmation Light Standard Template | Reminder Light Standard Template | Missed You Light Standard Template | Cancelled Light Standard Template | Thank You Light Standard Template | Invite Dark Standard Template | Confirmation Dark Standard Template | Reminder Dark Standard Template | Missed You Dark Standard Template | Cancelled Dark Standard Template | Thank You Dark If you create a new {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} from an existing record, you'll notice the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} displayed under the {{variable.Field_EmailTemplate_Name}} . This will help when deciding which {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} to use when cloning your new record.  If you do not see an {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} under the {{variable.Field_EmailTemplate_Name}} name that means an {{variable.Object_Event}} has not been associated with the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} yet. NOTE: When saving the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} , the {{variable.Field_EmailTemplate_Name}} length must be 80 characters or less, including the developer’s name (the unique date/time that is added to the end of the email template API name). Next, you'll see a page similar to the one below. The "Blackthorn University" image is pulled directly from the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} field on your {{variable.Object_Event}} . To add an image, drag and drop the Image tile from the Content section into the template.  Click "Browse" and you'll be presented with the File Manager. Use the Upload, Import, or Search free photos options to add images. Use the Upload button to add an image locally from your computer. Use the Import button to add an image via Facebook, Dropbox, One Drive, etc.   To upload an image via Salesforce Files, copy the public link from your image into the "Just provide the link" box.   To add merge fields, click on a text box, click "Merge Tags", and select the tag you want! Below is an example of some tags that could be used to display the event name, date, and time! Note: When adding in dates and times, please use the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} / {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartTime}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} / {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndTime}} to avoid issues with daylight savings time. When saving the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} , you can insert merge tags into the subject line as well. An example would be: "You're invited to {{{!conference360__Attendee__c.conference360__Event_Name__c}}}!" It's free rein from here. Play around and see what you can build. Edit Your Images You can also edit your image in the Email Template, with one exception. Adding rounded corners to images does not work with JPG files; it only works with PNG files. Complete the following steps to round the corners of a PNG image file. Open an existing Event record.  Scroll down to the Email Templates Related List. Click an existing Email Template. If you need to create a new Email Template, click {{variable.button_new}} and follow the instructions listed above. Click an existing image or add a new content row and upload a PNG image file.  Click Apply effects . Click the Corners icon.  Drag the Radius slider to the right until the corners are the correct shape.  Click Apply . (If the image is a JPG file, the empty corner spaces will be filled with a black background.) Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . The image's corners are now rounded. Once you are done editing the Email Template, click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Confirm the {{variable.Field_EmailMsg_Subject}} and click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Send Emails You can send emails from several places. If you don't see the following buttons on your Event page layout, please add them. Event Record Click the {{variable.Button_Event_SendEmail}} button on an {{variable.Object_Event}} record to send an email to all {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s specified in the criteria for the {{variable.Object_Event}} .  Attendee Record Click the {{variable.Button_Attendee_SendEmail}} button on an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record to send an email directly to that {{variable.Object_Attendee}} , and only that {{variable.Object_Attendee}} . Note: It may take several minutes for the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} to appear in the {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} . Experience Cloud Prerequisites When logged in to the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} as a Community user, you can preview and send emails from an Attendee or Event object after performing the following steps: Add a Sharing Setting to the Attendee object: Set the {{variable.Field_Attendee_DefExternalAcce}} field to “Public Read/Write” (Location: Setup > Settings > Security > Share Settings). Create a CSP Trusted Site: Set the {{variable.Field_TrustedSiteURL}} field set to “https://*.cloudfront.net" (Location: Setup > Settings > Security > CSP Trusted Sites > New Trusted Site). From the Event Record Select one of the following methods to send an email from an {{variable.Object_Event}} .  The {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_SendEmailFro}} address will determine which email address the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} is being sent from. By default, this is the Current User (the Salesforce user currently logged in.) Emails will be automatically added to this picklist by adding them to the Organization-Wide Email Addresses in Salesforce Setup. The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EmailTemplate}} field is where you can select which {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} to send. The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_AttendeeFilter}} field controls which {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s receive the email. This can be filtered by any selection within the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} field (Invited, Registered, etc.) or the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} field (Attended, No Show, etc.).   From the Attendee Record Select one of the following methods to send an email from an individual {{variable.Object_Attendee}} . The {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_SendEmailFro}} address is who the email comes from. By default, this is the Current User (the Salesforce user currently logged in). Emails will be automatically added to this picklist by adding the email to the Organization-Wide Email Addresses in Salesforce Setup. The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EmailTemplate}} field is where you can select which {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} to send.   Edit Your Email Template Open the {{variable.Object_Event}} record with the related {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} . Go to the related Email Template list and click {{variable.button_new}} . Select “New From Template.” Choose an {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} . Click {{variable.Button_Continue}} . Click the Row tab. In the template, select the row that you want to change the background color. Enter a hex # in the Row background color field. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .  Enter an {{variable.Field_EmailTemplate_Name}} and {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTemp_Subject}} if you want to rename the template. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . View Previously Created Email Templates To see the templates created with the Blackthorn Email Template Builder, you need to add the Blackthorn Custom Email Template object as a tab in your org. Complete the steps below to add a new tab to your app picker. Click the Gear icon. Click Setup . In the Quick Find box, search for and click “Tabs”. Click {{variable.button_new}} . Set {{variable.Field_TabSetup_Object}} to “Email Template”. Select a {{variable.Field_TabSetup_TabStyle}} . Click {{variable.Button_Next}} . Choose the visibility requirements for the tab. Click {{variable.Button_Next}} . Choose the custom apps where the new tab will be visible. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . The steps above will then add the Blackthorn Custom Email Template tab to your available app navigation items.  Recommendation: We suggest renaming this tab as it has the same name as the Salesforce Standard Email Template folder. FAQ “Refused to Connect” Error Q: I received a “refused to connect” error (i.e., ' domain.csxyz.visual.force.com refused to connect') when creating an Email Template through the Builder. What do I do? A: If you receive a refused to connect error (i.e., ' domain.csxyz.visual.force.com refused to connect') when creating an Email Template through the Builder, you must allowlist several domains in Salesforce. To allowlist the following three domains for Visualforce Pages, go to Setup > Session Settings. lightning.force.com ( http://lightning.force.com/ ) my.salesforce.com ( http://my.salesforce.com/ ) Your "My Domain" (for example, https://blackthorn--full.lightning.force.com ) Links Not Working Q: My {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s have reported that links in Yahoo are not showing up as hyperlinks, how do I fix this? A: Yahoo Mail does not automatically convert hyperlinks, unlike Google Mail, for example. To hyperlink merge fields, text, etc., please use the Link feature built into the {{variable.Component_EmailTemplateBuilder}} .  Add a Merge Field to a Button Q: Can I insert a merge field behind a button? A: Yes, you can. In the following example, we will add the Merge Tag for the {{variable.AttendeeLink}} to the Attend Event button. Open an {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} . Click in any area with text. Click Merge tags . Locate and click “Attendee -> AttendeeLink.”  Cut the merge tag and click the area with the Attend Event button. Paste the merge tag into the button’s Action URL field. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Enter a {{variable.Field_EmailMsg_Subject}} and click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Send the email invitation to your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. When your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s receive the email and click the Attend Event button, they will be taken to their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} .
